versions.changelog:
Initial release of douyin-mini-game-server-api — comprehensive OpenAPI skill for backend server integration:

- Covers all major Douyin mini-game server API functions: access token, login session, user cloud storage, QR code, notifications, gifts, group tags, sharing, and more.
- Includes detailed API references, best practices, sample code, and quick SDK selection for Java/NodeJS/Go.
- Highlights server-side login flow, token management strategies, signing requirements, and rate-limiting.
- Designed for backend developers building or debugging Douyin mini-game integrations.
